summary: Agent Core Runtime and Security Execution Foundation boundary is frozen as an accepted architecture decision.

boundary_decisions.agent_core: Deterministic orchestration inside agentd; not the model and not an executor.
boundary_decisions.security_execution_foundation: Only allowed path for side-effecting work: semantic tools, policy, capability leases, sandboxing, audit, verification, rollback, and recovery.
boundary_decisions.initial_process_boundary: In-process inside agentd for the first runtime implementation; future Unix socket boundary deferred until API stabilization.
boundary_decisions.distribution_alpha_gate: Blocked until generic AgentCore runtime and runtime safety gates pass.

acceptance.criterion: Agent Core responsibilities and non-responsibilities are explicit.
Security Execution Foundation remains the only way to prepare, execute, verify, seal, or roll back effects.
The boundary references existing MVP modules rather than inventing parallel paths.
Distribution Alpha is marked as blocked until the generic Agent run loop is available.

forbidden_paths: model output directly invoking a tool
planner invoking raw shell or host commands
Agent Core preparing EffectPrepared without Security Execution Foundation
Agent Core sealing commits without verification
tool observations directly creating follow-up high-risk actions
memory storing raw secret values or untrusted instructions without labels
sandbox profiles being weakened by planner or model hints
